scientific_claim: Separated clipped-gradient burst episodes act as discrete circuit rewrites. Under AdamW pressure, successive rewrites increase cyclic translation equivariance of the token embedding; the transition occurs when the equivariant representation and its readout consolidate after the forecast number of bursts.
prefix_inputs: materialized training batch inputs and targets
materialized transformer.wte.weight parameter versions at evaluation boundaries

order_parameter.name: cyclic_translation_equivariance
order_parameter.definition: R-squared of the off-diagonal centered token-embedding Gram matrix explained by cyclic group displacement
order_parameter.task_coordinate_inference: modular row reduction of observed atomic training equations only
